document: MC-04 independent review — Phase 1 interim findings
head: b0b010dd0b45eec455951393e0dabf1f3df53eca
note: Author artifacts are still landing while this snapshot was taken; items marked PENDING could not be reviewed because the deliverable did not exist yet. Every finding below is based on a real file or a command run in this session.

findings.title: 13/57 icons exceed the documented 2 px optical padding claim
findings.evidence: docs/marea/brand/evidence/review/raw/icon-bounds.json — Chromium getBBox() union + stroke/2 on the 24x24 grid. Declared padding: ink inside [2,22]. Violations by up to 1.5 units: alert-warning x[1,23], gps-fix x[1,23] y[1,23], nav-heading y[0.5,21], solar x/y[0.9,22], weather-forecast x[1.2,21.65] y[0.8,19], ais-receive-only y[1.34,22], battery/connection/fuse-breaker/installation/settings/shore-power/watch-monitoring by 0.5-1 unit.
findings.impact: Design rule vs actual geometry is inconsistent. The brief allows optical corrections (§9.2 'optical centring, not mathematical'), so the fix can be documentation (declare the nominal 2 px padding and the deliberate overshoots) or geometry. Not truthfulness-critical.
findings.disposition: OPEN — author correction or explicit exception record required before D-09 is final.

findings.title: Small-size distinctness is weak for several different-meaning icon pairs; the documented text-pairing list is incomplete
findings.evidence: docs/marea/brand/evidence/review/raw/icon-iou-strict.json (native raster at 16/24/32 px, strict ink mask, DPR-independent) and raw/icon-pair-compare-16px-dpr8.png. Ink-mask IoU at 16 px: ais-target <> ais-target-lost 0.909; device-display <> device-hub 0.875; wind-apparent <> wind-true 0.813; nav-heading <> position-marker 0.788; nav-north <> wind-sensor 0.765. ICONOGRAPHY-SYSTEM.md §8 lists only 6 icons as needing text pairing at 16 px and does not include device-hub/device-display or nav-heading/position-marker. The shapes are distinguishable on close inspection (da<shed vs solid triangle; three feet vs two + base), so this is a legibility/labelling gap, not a duplicated icon.
findings.impact: G1 small-size integrity evidence is weaker than the document implies; the icon system's own 'one metaphor per meaning' rule is satisfied in geometry but the 16 px cue for at least two pairs is marginal.
findings.disposition: OPEN — add the measured pairs to the documented 16 px text-pairing list (or strengthen the distinguishing cue), and let the independent design gate decide whether 16 px use is restricted.

findings.title: index.html says 'reduction variants 16/24/32' but the proof only scales the single 24 px master (no 16/20/48 variants)
findings.evidence: docs/marea/brand/evidence/review/raw/icon-html-audit.json: 240 inline SVGs, 57 distinct geometries, 57 identical to master geometry, 0 simplified variants; only stroke-width 2 and 1.25 present; no 48 px board. The reduction-proof prose itself is honest ('browser render proof of the 57 master icons ... not a marine-display or print test'); ICONOGRAPHY-SYSTEM.md §4/§8 disclose that 16 px is proof-only and a dedicated variant must be authored. The index wording 'Variantes de reducción 16/24/32' overstates what the board contains; brief §9.2 asks for 16/20/24/32/48 variants and 2 px at 16 px, which simple scaling does not deliver (2*16/24 = 1.33 px).
findings.impact: Documentation precision only; the substantive limitation is disclosed in ICONOGRAPHY-SYSTEM.md.
findings.disposition: OPEN — fix index wording and record the missing 16/20/48 variants as PENDING/NOT_PRODUCED.

findings.title: check-typography.mjs licence assertion 'oflDocumentExemption' is a false negative
findings.evidence: The script's regex requires '...does not apply to any document created using the fonts'; the shipped OFL-1.1 text reads '...does not apply to any document created using the Font Software.' so the check reports false. Independent evidence: docs/marea/brand/evidence/review/raw/typography-independent.json — both packages are OFL-1.1, no Reserved Font Name declared, and the document-creation clause IS present verbatim. Consequence: PDF/print embedding (T-8) is permitted under the shipped licence; MC-04 must not record 'document exemption not verified/denied'.
findings.impact: If D-06 or the delivery repeats the false value, the licence record misstates a permission (conservative direction, but still inaccurate). The substantive licence conclusion (OFL-1.1, keep both families) is unaffected.
findings.disposition: OPEN — correct the regex and make sure D-06/T-8 records the clause as verified-present.

findings.title: Mandatory disclaimer set incomplete on icon-adjacent surfaces
findings.evidence: Brief §7.7 mandates four disclaimer families (navigation, AIS, PILOT, weather). ICONOGRAPHY-SYSTEM.md §2.12 lists navigation, AIS and PILOT only; index.html carries AIS and PILOT verbatim but neither navigation nor weather, although the catalogue depicts navigation and weather icons. Scan: docs/marea/brand/evidence/review/raw/icon-html-audit.json disclaimersPresent (navigationES/EN false, weatherES/EN false, ais/pilot true).
findings.impact: Completeness of the §7.7 allocation; the icon catalogue is an internal proof sheet, not a product surface, which limits severity.
findings.disposition: OPEN — add the weather (and navigation where applicable) disclaimer text to the icon docs/proof sheet, or state why they do not apply.

findings.title: reduction-proof.html carries fewer honesty flags than index.html
findings.evidence: index.html flags INTERNO · PROPUESTO / PRODUCED / LEGAL_REVIEW_PENDING; reduction-proof.html flags INTERNO · PROPUESTO / PRODUCED only (raw/icon-html-audit.json). Both files also lack a visible 'professional originality check PENDING' statement, which ICONOGRAPHY-SYSTEM.md §0 does carry.
findings.impact: Consistency of PROPOSED/PENDING labelling across internal art surfaces.

findings.title: Instrument token JSON claims role-only names but the web-light baseline block uses legacy colour names
findings.evidence: document.roleNamesOnly says 'Token names are role-based, never colour-named (no --blue-500)', but modes.web-light.tokens contains navy2, sea, seaStrong, seaButton, badgeWarningBg, badgeSafeBg, badgeCriticalBg, badgeOffBg, themeColor. These mirror src/styles.scss and are a measured baseline, not the new instrument vocabulary.
findings.impact: Internal inconsistency in D-08 wording; no src/ change was made.
findings.disposition: OPEN — scope the role-naming rule to the instrument role sets and label the web-light block as a legacy baseline reference.

findings.title: Token JSON says the proposed focus ring 'resolves F-1', but the finding is only proposed, not resolved
findings.evidence: webTokenMapping.focusRing.relationship: 'replaces the failing focus colour; resolves F-1'. Independent recomputation (raw/contrast-independent.json): web-light focusRing is still #8fd2f5 at 1.6529:1 on #ffffff and 1.554:1 on #f2f9fd (AA 3:1 fail); only the PROPOSED instrument modes use #0f5f8c (6.92:1 / 6.50:1). Nothing is applied; brief §5.2/§12.4 requires MC-04 to *propose* a compliant value and MC-06 to implement it.
findings.impact: Wording overclaims a closed finding; the actual proposal exists and is compliant in the instrument modes.
findings.disposition: OPEN — change to 'proposes a compliant replacement; MC-06 implements; F-1 remains open for the live site'.

findings.title: MC-04-BRIEFS.yaml Spanish captions/alt text are stripped of diacritics
findings.evidence: raw/briefs-audit.json + direct byte check: the file contains 'fotografia' not 'fotografía', 'instalacion' not 'instalación', 'Rias Baixas' not 'Rías Baixas'. Only 16 non-ASCII characters in 87,498 B, all punctuation. Brief §1.4 rule 7 (ES first class) and §4.6 (accents designed, not patched); QA-11 alt text must be localised and correct.
findings.impact: Systemic localisation quality defect in the brief manifest; affects every ES alt/caption a future generated asset would inherit.
findings.disposition: OPEN — restore accents before any brief is consumed; the same captions in PHOTOGRAPHY-AND-CGI-ART-DIRECTION.md do carry accents, so the YAML is the outlier.

findings.title: scripts/check-typography.mjs was created outside any declared write scope
findings.evidence: The execution plan assigns scripts/check-contrast.mjs to TypeColour and scripts/render-assets.mjs / scripts/check-assets.mjs to AssetProduction; no member owns scripts/check-typography.mjs, yet the file exists and is cited by the token JSON. No src/ or public/ write occurred (git status clean for those paths).
findings.impact: Process/scope hygiene; the artifact itself is useful and read-only.
findings.disposition: OPEN — Lead records the authorization or updates the execution-plan write-scope table (Lead owns that file).
